gaps.description: MongoDB works collection lacks sanction_date and recommendation_date. Ingestion feed only captures completion_date and system timestamps.
gaps.impact: Statutory 45-day sanction window (Para 3.12) cannot be evaluated deterministically. Pre-2023 vs Post-2023 legal regime cut-off must rely on completion_date or assume 2023 regime as default.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: District Authority Administrative Sanction Order and Hon'ble MP Recommendation Letter

gaps.description: Ledger of previous-year uncommitted balances, cumulative interest accrued, and annual entitlement carry-forward is absent from MongoDB.
gaps.impact: Total MP sanction amounts cannot be reconciled against the statutory annual limit of ₹5 Crore without risking false accusations on legitimate multi-year carry-forward funds.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: State Nodal Department / MoSPI Annual Financial Allocation & Expenditure Ledger

gaps.description: NGO Darpan ID, Trust/Society registration certificate number, and incorporation date are completely absent from work records.
gaps.impact: Statutory requirements for 3-year prior existence (Para 3.23) and mandatory Darpan registration cannot be evaluated in automated pipelines.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: NITI Aayog NGO Darpan Portal Verification and Society Registration Certificate

gaps.description: Names and national identity records of Society/Trust trustees, presidents, and secretaries are absent from database.
gaps.impact: Statutory prohibition against MP or family member involvement in Trust/Society management (Para 3.23) cannot be evaluated automatically.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: Trust Deed / Memorandum of Association and MP Non-Involvement Affidavit

gaps.description: Records of land ownership, revenue survey numbers, title deeds, and No Objection Certificates (NOC) are absent.
gaps.impact: Statutory prohibition against asset creation on private or disputed commercial land (Para 3.22) cannot be evaluated deterministically.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: District Land Revenue Record / Village Land Register / IDA Land NOC

gaps.description: Tender IDs, bidding documents, GeM contract references, and procurement mode are missing. Only a free-text primary_vendor string exists in 68.89% of records.
gaps.impact: Compliance with State Financial Rules / GeM procurement mandate (Para 3.16) cannot be verified directly.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: District Planning Office Tender File / GeM Portal Contract Docket

gaps.description: Logs of District Authority 10% inspections and State 1% inspections, officer sign-offs, and inspection dates are missing.
gaps.impact: Cannot verify whether the statutory 10% DA inspection mandate (Para 6.4) has been fulfilled.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: District Collector / Planning Officer Physical Inspection Register

gaps.description: No media attachments, photograph URLs, geo-tagged coordinate images, or plaque inscription records are stored in MongoDB.
gaps.impact: The existing rule flag 'completed_without_image' was set as an unverified portal artifact. True plaque compliance cannot be checked.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: Mobile App Geo-tagged Photo Archive / Physical Plaque Inspection

gaps.description: Village and ward demographic population data (SC/ST proportions) is absent from the project database.
gaps.impact: Advisory recommendation targets (15% SC, 7.5% ST per Para 2.4) cannot be measured at the ward/village or MP level.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: Census Demographic Registry / District Planning SC/ST Sub-Plan Ledger

gaps.description: Official Gazette notifications declaring severe natural calamities (Para 2.8) are not cross-referenced in MongoDB.
gaps.impact: Works outside MP constituency recommended under disaster exceptions cannot be automatically exempted without manual verification.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: Ministry of Home Affairs / State Disaster Management Authority Notification

gaps.description: Granular payment vouchers, contractor bill submissions, and milestone disbursements are missing. Only total_fund_disbursed exists.
gaps.impact: Line-item reconciliation between sanctioned estimates and actual contractor payments is impossible from portal data.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: IDA Treasury Payment Vouchers and Executing Agency MB (Measurement Book)

gaps.description: Detailed village, block, ward, PIN code, and GPS coordinates are absent. Only state, constituency, and IDA name are available.
gaps.impact: Intra-constituency duplicate detection cannot verify if works are at the exact same physical site or legitimate adjacent assets.
gaps.recommended_auditor_source: Detailed Project Report (DPR) Site Map and Local Authority Work Order
